text:
emma: quick alert — customer POC failing. Node+Python sampleapps return different embed dims when using the new batch helper. Node -> 512, Python -> 384.

rafael: any recent helper changes?

emma: Python added `pad_to_len` and `trim_zero_tail=true` in a refactor; Node uses `pad_to`. Python is trimming trailing zeros before sending, so dims differ.

lina: that explains the index mismatches. also found rerank `scores` coming back as strings from older python client: `['0.8','0.4']` -> type error in comparator.

sdk-qa: repro steps: run node sampleapp, run python sampleapp, POST mixed-length arrays to /embed-batch, compare embedding lengths and rerank score types. Observed retry misbehavior: python retryer doesn't set `Idempotency-Key` header, causing duplicate inserts on 409.

emma: plan: 1) rename python option to `pad_to` and set `trim_zero_tail=false` by default, 2) map internal retry id to `Idempotency-Key`, 3) add client-side schema check (all embeddings same length, scores numeric).

lina: i'll open PRs: sdk-python fix + tests, and a small server guard to include `response.meta.embedding_dim` and 400 if batch lengths vary.

sdk-qa: adding cross-sdk integration test that runs Node+Python sampleapps with 100 randomized inputs and asserts dims match and scores are floats.

infra-bot: ci: triggered pipeline for sdk-python PR #1802 (unit,lint,int).

rafael: ETA on python hotfix?

lina: quick patch in ~1.5h, will run integration in staging then cut a patch release.

emma: also drafting a tiny DB cleanup to dedupe rows created by earlier mismatch; will coordinate with infra.

sdk-qa: staging run results: dims normalized after patch, rerank scores parsed as floats, no duplicate inserts in 2k requests.

emma: thanks all ":thumbsup:" — we'll update onboarding docs to show `pad_to` example and note idempotency header behavior.
